evidence: Maintainer's bike: speed limits 16, 25, 32 and 45 km/h confirmed by echo and by riding with the app; back to 25 km/h after a restart (tested at 16, 32 and 45).

Speed tracked a hand-spun wheel; max speed, odometer, assist level, battery, lights and display on/off compared with the bike's display; temperature, battery health, voltage and total ride time compared with the ENGWE app.
Assist levels 0 to 5 set with the app; the bike's display showed each level set.
Locked and unlocked with the ENGWE app: the bike answered with its lock state, and its status and display showed it off, then on.
